rows.text: 并不垂直于两系统相对运动的速度，而是与此速度平行.
棒的一端$(A)$发射出来的光脉
冲被位于棒的另一端$(B)$的镜子反
射，并经过用在参考系$K_1$中静止
的钟测定的时间间隔$\tau_0$以后又返回
来(图224). 静止的棒的长度$l_0$与
时间$\tau_0$的比例关系为
用在系统$K$中静止的钟测定的这两个事件之间的(从$A$点发射信
号和此信号从镜$B$反射后回到此点)时间间隔用$\tau$来表示. 间隔$\tau_0$和
$\tau$由公式(8.1)相互联系.
如果$\tau_1$是光信号从$A$到$B$的运动时间，$\tau_2$是此信号反方向运动的
时间，则
$\tau=\tau_1+\tau_2$.
图225中所示为棒相对于参考系$K$在各个不同时刻上的位置: 在闪光
发生的时刻在$AB$位置，过了时间$\tau_1$后在$A_1B_1$位置，过了时间$\tau_1+\tau_2$
后在$A_2B_2$位置. 在时间$\tau_1$内，棒相对于系统$K$移动了$v\tau_1$距离. 光脉
冲在从$A$到$B$运动时走过的路程从与系统$K$相联系的观察者的角度
来看，等于$l+v\tau_1$(其中$l$为运动着的棒的长度). 所以可以写出下列
方程式

topology: One coordinate frame K_1 with common origin O_1; Y_1 points upward, X_1 rightward, Z_1 diagonally down-left.
One horizontal stippled rod AB, A at its left end and B at its right end, aligned along the X_1 direction.
Above the rod are two parallel horizontal light-path tracks bounded at A and B; upper arrow points A-to-B/right, lower arrow B-to-A/left.
The left and right vertical endpoint construction strokes enclose the rod and extend below it.
A double-headed horizontal dimension below the rod spans A to B and is labeled l_0.
givens: Light goes from A to mirror B and returns

figures.caption: 图225
figures.source_region: Large lower-page diagram between prose ending 角度 and resuming 来看; excludes external caption and both surrounding prose segments.
topology: Two coordinate frames: stationary K with O, X right, Y up, Z down-left; moving K_1 with O_1, X_1 right, Y_1 up, Z_1 down-left.
O_1 is right of O along the shared horizontal baseline. Distinct arrowheads/labels for X and X_1 remain; the Y/Y_1 and Z/Z_1 axes are separate.
A right-pointing velocity arrow near upper Y_1 carries vector v.
Three equal-length horizontal rod positions stacked downward and shifted successively right: shaded top AB, unshaded middle A_1B_1, unshaded bottom A_2B_2.
Endpoint ordering is A < A_1 < A_2 < B < B_1 < B_2 in horizontal position.
Top AB is on the baseline; middle A_1B_1 and bottom A_2B_2 are below it. Every A/B label belongs to its own rod endpoint.

Vertical construction strokes anchor A, A_1, A_2 and B_1; the B_1 stroke extends from the upper total-distance dimension through the lower dimension, crossing the lower rod interior rather than ending at B_2.
Upper double-headed dimension runs from A to B_1 and is labeled l+v tau_1.
First short double-headed displacement runs A-to-A_1 and is labeled v tau_1.
Second short double-headed displacement runs A_1-to-A_2 and is labeled v tau_2.
Bottom double-headed dimension runs from A_2 to the B_1 construction line and is labeled l-v tau_2.
Only the first rod is stippled; the other two interiors stay white.
givens: Rod displacement v tau_1 then v tau_2
